products.name: Artisanal Cold-Pressed Neem & Tea Tree Botanical Balm

benefits: Traditionally used to comfort dry, flaky, or sensitive skin patches

Zero petrochemicals, parabens, synthetic fragrances, or fillers
Moisture-locking protective barrier made with raw African shea

products.name: Wild Rift Hibiscus & Sun-Dried Lemongrass Tisane
products.description: Handcrafted loose-leaf herbal blend of ruby Kenyan hibiscus calyces, aromatic wild lemongrass, and whole peppermint leaves. Delivers a tart, refreshing ruby-red infusion packed with anthocyanins and vitamin C.

Caffeine-free refreshing hydration for any hour of the day
Naturally abundant in vitamin C and polyphenols
Supports gentle digestion after meals
